The nonflat adjacent-path spinor defect is exactly a transported (Omega-1) multiple.
The defect inner product equals the exact curvature amplitude factor times the input inner product.
The explicit Omega=-1 cube has a nonzero basis-spinor defect.
nonclaims: No full coarse/fine seven-factor walk intertwining is proved.
No operator-norm curvature bound or scale-decay estimate is proved.
No neighboring-cell gluing theorem is proved.
No continuum Dirac or gauge-field convergence is proved.
No dynamical gauge, gravitational, or cosmological equation is proved.
